items.headline: U.S. Stocks Dip as Fed Chair Warsh Signals Hawkish Stance on Inflation
items.summary: U.S. equity markets closed lower on Friday, August 28, with all three major indices experiencing slight declines. The market reacted to hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh, who emphasized commitment to reducing inflation, fueling expectations of potential interest rate hikes. This sentiment drove Treasury yields higher and generally dampened investor appetite for riskier assets. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Tata Consultancy Services soars on IT rally in India.
items.summary: TCS (India) closed 4.16% higher, contributing to a surge in the Nifty IT index, driven by a buoyant outlook for software and consulting firms.

items.headline: Elastic surges over 18% on strong earnings.
items.summary: Shares of Elastic were up more than 18% following its positive quarterly earnings release.

items.headline: Amazon posts solid gains.
items.summary: Amazon ($AMZN) saw solid gains, rising 3.97% to $266.43.

items.headline: Marvell Technology sinks despite earnings beat.
items.summary: Marvell Technology ($MRVL) fell more than 9% despite reporting better-than-expected earnings, possibly due to a significant rally preceding the report.

items.headline: Rubrik declines 11% after solid results.
items.summary: Rubrik ($RBRK) was down 11% at midday, even after reporting solid results, likely influenced by cautious investor sentiment following a significant rally.

items.headline: Nvidia gives back post-earnings surge.
items.summary: Nvidia ($NVDA) slid over 3.5%, reversing a portion of its post-earnings surge from Thursday.

items.headline: Fed Chair Warsh Delivers Hawkish Remarks at Jackson Hole
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium underscored the Fed's commitment to tackling high inflation. His remarks were interpreted as hawkish, leading to higher Treasury yields and increasing the implied probability of a September rate hike to almost 60%.

items.headline: U.S. Sector Rotation: Consumer Discretionary and Communication Services Lead, Tech Lags
items.summary: In the U.S. markets, Consumer Discretionary (+1.7%) and Communication Services (+1.6%) sectors posted solid gains, largely driven by companies like Amazon and Alphabet. Conversely, the Information Technology sector was among the laggards (-1.29%), with the PHLX Semiconductor Index falling 3.5%. Utilities (-1.1%) and Industrials (-1.0%) also experienced weakness.

items.headline: Indian IT Sector Surges Amid Positive Global Outlook
items.summary: In contrast to some U.S. tech softness, India's Nifty IT index emerged as the top performer, rising over 3%. This surge was attributed to a buoyant outlook for US-based software and consulting firms following strong quarterly earnings, such as those from Salesforce.

items.headline: Mixed Earnings Reactions: Elastic Soars, Marvell and Rubrik Dip
items.summary: Earnings reports brought mixed reactions. Elastic saw its stock climb over 18% on strong quarterly results. Salesforce reported strong Q2 2026 results and raised its full-year guidance for 2027. However, Marvell Technology and Rubrik, despite beating analyst expectations, saw their shares decline significantly, possibly reflecting investor caution after previous rallies.
